english:
An <arc Arc /> pickup that homes in on you at 6 meters per second. Picking it up grants 11.25% Grenade and Melee Ability Energy, and 13.5% Class Ability Energy.

Allies cannot pick up <arc Ionic Traces /> you create.

#ChunkEnergyScalars

source.text:
Arc Elemental Pickup.

Energizing Seekers that home in towards the user at a speed of 6m/s.
Grants 11.25% Grenade, and Melee Ability Energy, and 13.5% Class Ability Energy on pickup. Allies do not receive Ionic Traces created by the user.
